title: 第一章    讨债
content_zh:
“醒醒，陈木，不要睡了，不就是收了一点挫折吗，男子汉大丈夫没什么好气馁的，整天睡觉，你看你现在都成什么样子了，再说你还有我啊，我永远都是你兄弟。”

    余北有些苦笑的看着已经喝了好几天的酒，一直郁郁不欢的陈木，心里有些叹息，平时自己这个兄弟很安静也很低调，虽然是大少爷，但从来不与人结仇，经常有很多人想跟着做他的小弟，不过自己这位兄弟从来不收不说，还非常厌恶这点，因此很多人都对他心有不满。

    就在上个礼拜，陈木竟然查出来不是陈家的种，这在大家族是非常严重的事情，所以结果就是被赶出了陈家。

    余北的话并没有让陈木醒过来，依然躺在那一动不动，仿若睡死了过去，如果不是还有着微微的打呼声，余北还真怕他是出了什么事情。

    “唉。”

    余北微微一叹，准备离开宿舍，他已经尽力了

    砰！

    “啊！”

    不过让余北没有想到的是，陈木大叫一声，从床上蹦了起来，或者说整个人从床上弹了起来，余北顿时瞪大了眼睛，被陈木吓了一大跳，随机心里一喜，这还是他这两天头一次看到床上的男生起来。

    “陈木！你做什么，你要吓死我啊！”余北半开玩笑的说了陈木一句，既然已经起床了，而且看精神还不错，想来应该恢复了。

    陈木起来后，没有理睬余北，眼中有些迷茫，看着四周，四个木头架的床，床下面还有着书桌，这些书桌上好像还有着一些东西，眉头皱了皱眉，看向了刚刚跟他说话的余北，疑惑道：“你是谁？这是那里？”

    余北一愣，有些同情的看了陈木一眼，心想这家伙不会因为被赶出了家族，变傻了吧：“陈木，我知道你现在心里不好受，不过凡事都会过去的，待会要上课了，咱们一起走吧。”

    陈木皱着眉头看着眼前的男生，没有说话，余北不知道陈木在想什么，便继续说道：“你肚子应该饿了吧，我请你吃饭去？”

    看着眼前的男生，他说的话似乎不是苍月大陆的话，但自己却能听得懂，这是怎么回事？陈木皱眉想到
content_en:
"Wake up, Chen Mu, don't sleep anymore. Isn't it just a little bit of frustration? A man has nothing to be discouraged. He sleeps all day long. Look what you have become now. Besides, you still have me. I will always be your brother."

Yu Bei looked at Chen Mu who had been drinking for several days with a wry smile and sighed in his heart. Usually his brother is very quiet and low-key. Although he is the eldest young master, he never makes enemies with others. There are often many people who want to follow him and become his younger brother. However, his brother never accepts it and hates it very much. Therefore, many people are dissatisfied with him.

Just last week, Chen Mu found out that he was not a descendant of the Chen family. This was a very serious matter in a big family, so he was kicked out of the Chen family.

Yu Bei's words did not make Chen Mu wake up. He was still lying there motionless, as if he had fallen asleep. If he hadn't been snoring slightly, Yu Bei would have been really afraid that something had happened to him.

"Alas."

Yu Bei sighed slightly and prepared to leave the dormitory. He had tried his best.

Bang!

"Ah!"

But what Yu Bei didn't expect was that Chen Mu screamed and jumped up from the bed, or he jumped up from the bed. Yu Bei's eyes suddenly widened and he was startled by Chen Mu. He was overjoyed. This was the first time he saw a boy on the bed getting up in the past two days.

"Chen Mu! What are you doing? You're going to scare me to death!" Yu Bei said half-jokingly to Chen Mu. Since he had already gotten up and seemed to be in good spirits, he should have recovered.

After Chen Mu got up, he ignored Yu Bei and looked a little confused. He looked around at the four wooden beds and desks under the beds. There seemed to be some things on these desks. He frowned and looked at Yu Bei who had just spoken to him, wondering: "Who are you? Where is this place?"

Yu Bei was stunned and glanced at Chen Mu with some sympathy, thinking that this guy wouldn't have become stupid because he was kicked out of the family: "Chen Mu, I know you feel bad now, but everything will pass. There will be classes later, let's go together."

Chen Mu frowned and looked at the boy in front of him without saying anything. Yu Bei didn't know what Chen Mu was thinking, so he continued: "You must be hungry, should I treat you to a meal?"
